purpose: Everything needed to check a record without a repository checkout: the closed schema for its shape, the fixture for its bytes, the pinned digest for its identity and one command that asserts all three.
no_checkout_inference: A reader needs this directory and the two source files named below. No field, bound or digest is left to be inferred from the implementation.

vectors.note: single normative source of executable cases; this bundle points at it and does not restate it

fixtures.non_secret: contains fixture identities and a public test key only; no credential value appears
contains fixture identities and a public test key only; no credential value appears
contains fixture identities and a public test key only; no credential value appears
contains fixture identities and a public test key only; no credential value appears
contains fixture identities and a public test key only; no credential value appears

negative_arms.name: the commitment cannot carry a derived identity
an identity must exist inside the hashed bytes
a higher layer must name the lower-layer digest
an unknown launch state is refused, never coerced
a count may not be negative
a cancellation must state its applied phase
the bound is enforced by the schema
a precommit record never names a commit
publication must state the ancestry judgment
a lower layer may not include a higher-layer digest
a nullable field must be present and null
a criterion with no argv is not executable
an unknown enumeration value is refused

shape_only.what: the repeated `a` digest in IV.3 protocol examples
shape_only.why: a placeholder for wire shape, not a claim about stored bytes
deterministic test key derived from a published seed; it authorizes nothing outside this fixture

previous_build.note: pass-6 revision; it predates this bundle and is not evidence for it

pdf_relation.rule: this bundle pins source digests, not PDF bytes. A PDF built from other sources, or from these sources after any pinned digest changes, is a different artifact and the manifest must be re-frozen before it may be cited
pdf_relation.reissue_owner: wave 4 (P7-14 figures, P7-16 Part IX dispositions)

runner.pass_means: every pinned digest matched, every positive binding validated against its schema, every negative arm was refused, and every digest check recomputed
runner.fail_means: at least one of those did not hold; the failure line names which

checks_this_bundle_cannot_make: a live deployment implements the contract (that needs a version-bound execution receipt)
the fixture's test key is trusted anywhere (it is not)
the shipped PDF matches these sources (that is a build-time question, answered by rebuilding)
